The company will release the Vampire Hunter D : Fortress of Blood comic on December 16 and will release the English translation of Vampire Hunter D : Rose…

title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Season 2 Trailer Hints at a Very Different Story
content: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners will continue to explore the animated world of Night City, fleshing out the universe that first started with CD Projekt Red’s video game, Cyberpunk 2077 . The first season, at this point, is considered anime royalty by many fans, as the story of David and Lucy resonated deeply with many.

title: Blue Eye Samurai Confirms Final Season Release With New Season 2 Trailer
content: In 2023, Netflix created one of the most critically acclaimed animated series to ever arrive on the streaming service: Blue Eye Samurai . While a second season has been known to arrive on the platform for some time, many fans were wondering what the future would hold for Mizu and her quest for vengeance.

title: 'Kikansha no Mahou wa Tokubetsu desu 2nd Season' Reveals New Staff, First Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Yu So-nan and Uk-jakga 's Kikansha no Mahou wa Tokubetsu desu ( A Returner's Magic Should Be Special ) manhwa revealed new staff and the first promotional video for its second season on Friday. The anime will air in October 2026 every Thursday at 12.45 a.m.

title: Kakao Games Announces The World of Dokkaebi MMORPG Based on Web Novel With October Launch
content: Kakao Games announced on August 6 that it will launch Supercat's The World of Dokkaebi , a new MMORPG based on the web novel Chronicles of the Demon-Slaying Cultivator , in October. The World of Dokkaebi combines 2D pixel-art characters with 3D environments and draws on Korean folklore and Eastern fantasy.
author: ANN
